title: List's store-scan fallback for an unindexed field filter only applies on the first page
answers: list with field selector fails or errors on the second page
pagination breaks after index rejects a selectable field filter
why isn't the store scan fallback happening for a later page
continue token error with field selectors
body: server.List (server.go) falls back from search to a full store scan when the search backend returns IsSelectableFieldNotIndexed(err), but server.searchForList (list_with_selectors.go) only triggers that fallback (returns errSearchCannotAnswerList) when req.NextPageToken == "". On a later page the token carries SearchAfter/SearchBefore positions from the search index that a store scan has no way to resume from, so the refusal error is passed straight to the caller instead. Any new 'search cannot answer this' case added to searchForList must keep the first-page-only condition or pagination correctness breaks.
